docs.title: Environment variables
docs.text:
Every env var the framework and its packages read.

How to read your own keys with the typed env class is on the Environment Variables page.

The code reads env vars in three ways:

  • Env.get() and EnvReader (dox_core): a real environment variable wins over the .env file.
  • Platform.environment straight: only the real environment, .env is not read.
  • dox_migration has its own loadEnv(): it reads .env and the real environment. A real environment variable wins, the same as Env.get().

docs.title: Read by the framework
docs.text:
If APP_ENV is not set or empty, Dox treats the app as production: /docs is off and error details are hidden. Set APP_ENV=development in your .env and in CI.

Variable Who reads it Default Meaning Example APP_ENV dox_core, dox_auth, dox_view empty Any value except development, local, test or testing (also empty) makes a bad APP_KEY a startup error: missing, not exactly 32 characters, or a public sample key. The same rule applies to a JWT secret shorter than 32 bytes (dox_auth). In development, local, test and testing both are only a warning. development or local also: show error details in 500 responses and in health check answers, turn the /docs routes on when openApi.enabled is null, and turn the template cache of dox_view off. testing as a real environment variable also loads .env.testing (see below). Read with Env.get. APP_ENV=production APP_NAME dox_core (Cache) not set The default prefix of a redis cache store: My Shop gives my_shop_cache:. So two apps on one Redis do not share keys. APP_NAME="My Shop" APP_URL dox_core (Route.signedUrl) not set The scheme and host in front of an absolute signed URL. APP_URL=https://example.com PORT dox_core (DoxServer.portFor()) not set The port to listen on, when APP_PORT is not set. Cloud Run, Fly, Render and Heroku set it. APP_PORT wins when both are set. Read with Env.get. PORT=8080 APP_HOST dox_core (DoxServer.hostFor()) not set (all interfaces, ::) The host to listen on. 127.0.0.1 keeps the app off the network, for an app behind a proxy on the same machine. AppConfig.host wins over it. Read with Env.get. APP_HOST=127.0.0.1 DATABASE_URL dox_orm (DatabaseConfig.url), dox_migration not set A database url. When it is set, it wins over DB_CONNECTION and the other DB_* keys. dox_orm reads it from the real environment only. See Database url. DATABASE_URL=postgres://app:secret@db:5432/blog?sslmode=require DB_CONNECTION dox_migration (DbConnection.config()) postgres postgres, mysql or sqlite. Any other value means postgres. DB_CONNECTION=sqlite DB_HOST dox_migration localhost Database host. A path that starts with / is a Unix socket: the folder for Postgres, the socket file for MySQL. DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT dox_migration 5432 (postgres), 3306 (mysql) Database port. DB_PORT=5432 DB_USERNAME dox_migration postgres (postgres), root (mysql) Database user. DB_USERNAME=app DB_PASSWORD dox_migration postgres (postgres), empty (mysql) Database password. DB_PASSWORD=secret DB_DATABASE dox_migration falls back to DB_NAME, then dox Database name. For sqlite: the file path. DB_DATABASE=dox DB_NAME dox_migration dox Same as DB_DATABASE. DB_DATABASE wins when both are set. DB_NAME=dox HOME / USERPROFILE build hooks of dox_http_native, dox_postgres_native, dox_mysql_native empty Used to find ~/.cargo/bin/cargo when the library must be built from source. set by the OS DART_VM_OPTIONS the Dart VM not set Flags for the VM. The AOT binary from dox build reads it. Dox never sets VM flags for you. See Performance. DART_VM_OPTIONS=--new_gen_semi_max_size=64

docs.title: Read by a new project
docs.text:
A new project (dox create) reads these keys through its typed env class, lib/config/env.dart. The framework itself does not read them. In code, use the getter: env.appPort.

Variable Getter Type Default Used for APP_NAME appName String dox LoggerConfig.name. APP_ENV appEnv String production development, staging or production. env.isDevelopment is true for development. It turns on prettyPrint of the logger and the query log of the database. Any value except production turns on LogMiddleware in the new project (one log line per request, if the logger is enabled). Also read by the framework (see above). APP_PORT appPort int 3000 AppConfig.serverPort. When APP_PORT is not set, Dox listens on PORT if the env has it. APP_KEY appKey String required AppConfig.appKey. It must be exactly 32 characters. Run dox key:generate for one. The app stops at start when it is missing, has another length, or is a public sample key (only a warning in development, local, test and testing). APP_TOTAL_ISOLATE appTotalIsolate int? not set: one per CPU core AppConfig.totalIsolate. LOG_LEVEL logLevel String info LoggerConfig.level. CACHE_STORE cacheStore String file CacheConfig.defaultStore. A new project has the stores file and memory in lib/config/cache.dart. Add a redis store there before you use it. STORAGE_DISK storageDisk String local StorageConfig.defaultDisk. A new project has the disk local in lib/config/storage.dart. Add an s3 or memory disk there before you use it. DB_CONNECTION dbConnection String sqlite DatabaseConfig.connection: sqlite, postgres or mysql. DB_NAME dbName String db/dox.sqlite The database name. For SQLite: the file path. DB_HOST dbHost String localhost Database host. DB_PORT dbPort int? not set: 5432 for Postgres, 3306 for MySQL Database port. DB_USERNAME dbUsername String postgres Database user. DB_PASSWORD dbPassword String empty Database password.

To add a key, add a getter to AppEnv and run dart run build_runner build. See Environments.

The .env.example of a new project:

.env.example
APP_NAME=dox
APP_ENV=development
APP_PORT=3000
APP_KEY=

CACHE_STORE=file
STORAGE_DISK=local

# SQLite needs no setup. The file is created at the first start.
DB_CONNECTION=sqlite
DB_NAME=db/dox.sqlite

# Postgres or MySQL: set DB_CONNECTION=postgres or mysql and fill these in.
DB_HOST=localhost
DB_PORT=5432
DB_USERNAME=postgres
DB_PASSWORD=postgres

docs.title: How .env is parsed
docs.text:
Env.parse() in packages/dox-core/lib/env/env.dart:

  • One KEY=value per line. The key is trimmed. A line that starts with # is a comment.
  • The value is everything after the first =. A second = is kept.
  • # after a space starts a comment: KEY=abc # note gives abc. KEY=abc#def stays abc#def.
  • A value in quotes (", ' or `) is kept as it is, also a #. The quotes are removed.
  • An empty value (KEY=), or the text null, counts as missing. So Env.get gives the default.
  • export KEY=value is read like KEY=value.
  • With CoreFlags.envExpand, ${OTHER} and "..." escapes work. See Use one value in another.
  • The file is read once per isolate, from the current working directory.
  • In tests (dart test, or APP_ENV=testing as a real environment variable), Dox also reads .env.testing next to .env. Its keys win over the keys of .env. A real environment variable still wins over both.

dox_migration has its own simpler parser. It removes every quote character and does not strip # note comments. It does not read .env.testing. Keep comments on their own line.

docs.title: Error index
docs.text:
This page lists the messages Dox prints or throws, so you can search for the text you see.

  • <...> is a part that changes, like a name or a number.
  • Dart adds a prefix to some errors: Bad state: (StateError), Invalid argument(s): (ArgumentError), Unsupported operation: (UnsupportedError), Exception: (Exception).
  • For problems that need a longer story, see Troubleshooting.

docs.title: dox_core: start of the app
docs.text: Text When What to do APP_KEY is not set. Rundox key:generateand put the key in .env appKey is empty. A StateError stops the app, unless APP_ENV is development, local, test or testing. Then it is only a warning. Run dox key:generate, or set APP_KEY in the env. APP_KEY must be exactly 32 characters. Rundox key:generate`` The key is shorter or longer. Same rule as above. Run dox key:generate. APP_KEY is a public sample key. Rundox key:generatefor a new one The key is a known sample key. Same rule as above. Run dox key:generate. Unsupported operation: dox_http_native did not load: <reason>. Fix: ... The native HTTP library is missing or from another version (native library ABI <x>, expected <y>). The app stops at start. Do what the Fix: part says. See Troubleshooting. Server started at http://<host>:<port> with <n> isolate (native) Normal start. <host> is the address it listens on: [::] means all interfaces. Nothing. Windows: the native server runs on one isolate Windows has no SO_REUSEPORT. Nothing. Socket.IO runs on <n> isolates: clients should use transports: ['websocket'] ... Socket.IO with more than one isolate and long-polling on. Use transports: ['websocket'] in the client. [dox] isolate <n> error: <error> An error killed a worker isolate. The stack is on the next line. Fix the error. Dox restarts the isolate. [dox] isolate <n> exited, restarting A worker isolate died. A new one starts after 1 second. Look at the error line above it. SocketException: dox_http_native: bind failed (<code>) (OS Error: errno = <errno>), port = <port> The port is in use. See Troubleshooting.

docs.title: dox_core: routes and controllers
docs.text:
These stop the app at start, so a bad route never reaches a request.

Text When What to do Route <where>: the controller parameter type <T> is not known. Use DoxRequest, a @Dto class, an @Inject class, a @DoxModel, a type from Route.bind, or String, int, double, num, bool for path params. ... A controller parameter has another type, the DTO is not in AppConfig.dtos, the class is not in the container, or there is no Route.bind<T> for a {param} of the route. Change the type or add the binder. Run dart run build_runner build, and set dtos: dtos and container: registerContainer in AppConfig. Route <where>: the action gives a function. Give it one controller parameter from the container, like (UserController c) => c.index. ... A route action like (c) => c.index where Dox can not find the controller class. Give the parameter its type, and mark the controller class with @Inject(). Bad state: <T> is not in the container. Add @Inject() above the class and rundart run build_runner build. ... Dox needs a class that is not in the container. Do what the text says, and set AppConfig(container: registerContainer). Route name "<name>" is used twice: <method> <path> and <method> <path>. Two routes have the same name. Give one of them another name. Invalid argument (name): No route has this name: "<name>" route() or Route.url() with a name that no route has. Check the name and the group name: prefix. Invalid argument(s): Route "<name>" (<path>) needs the param "<param>". route() without a value for a {param}. Pass it in params:. Invalid argument(s): An absolute url needs a host. ... route() with absolute: true and no APP_URL and no baseUrl:. Set APP_URL, or pass baseUrl:. Bad state: No bound value of type <T> for the route param "<param>". ... req.bound<T>() for a param with no Route.bind, or of another type. Add Route.bind<T>('<param>', ...). Route <where>: the controller has more path params than the route has {...} params (<n>). The method asks for more path params than the path has. Add the {param} to the path, or remove the parameter. Route <where>: a controller can have one @Dto only. Two DTO parameters. Merge them into one DTO. Route <where>: only positional parameters are supported, not named or [optional] ones (<type>). Named or [optional] parameters. Use positional parameters. Use int? with {id?} for an optional param. Route <where>: a controller can not be generic. The handler has type parameters. Remove them. Route <where>: can not read the controller type <type>. Dox can not read the function type of the handler. Use a plain method or function.

docs.title: dox_core: env
docs.text:
Text When What to do EnvException: the env is not valid then - <KEY> is missing AppEnv.load() found a required key with no value. Set the key, or give the getter a default. - <KEY> must be <type>, not "<value>" A value does not fit the getter type. Fix the value. Check for a # comment after it. Env key "<KEY>" is not set and has no default Env.get<int>(), <num>, <double> or <bool> with no value and no default. Set the key, or pass a default. Env key "<KEY>" is not a valid <type>: "<value>" Env.get<int>() (or another type) got text that is not that type. Fix the value.

See Environment variables.

docs.title: dox_core: requests (what the client gets)
docs.text:
An IHttpException with a text message answers {"code":"<errorCode>","message":"<text>"}. The table shows the message text.

Status Message When What to do 404 <METHOD> <path> not found No route matches. Check the method, the path and the router prefix. 404 Not Found A typed path param does not fit, like abc for int id, or a Route.bind finds no row. Send a valid value. 400 The body is not valid JSON A DTO reads a JSON body that does not parse. Send valid JSON. 400 The form body is not valid A urlencoded body that can not be decoded. Fix the client encoding. 415 Unsupported Media Type A DTO reads a body that is not JSON or form data. Send Content-Type: application/json or form data. 413 Payload Too Large The body is bigger than maxBodySize or maxMultipartSize. Send less, or raise the limit. 419 CSRF token mismatch CsrfMiddleware finds no CSRF token, or a wrong one, on a POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE. Send the token. See CSRF. 429 Too Many Requests A RateLimit middleware sees too many requests. The Retry-After header says how many seconds to wait. Wait, then try again. See Rate limiting. 422 {"_root":"The input has too many items (max 1000) or levels (max 10)"} Form or query keys with more than 1000 list items or 10 levels. Send less nested data. 422 {"<field>":"<message>"} A DTO check failed. With the flag laravelErrors the body is {"message":"...","errors":{"<field>":["..."]}}. See Core flags. See Validation rules. 431 (no text) Native server: request line plus headers over 16 KB. Send smaller headers or cookies. 500 Server Error, code server_error. When APP_ENV is development or local, the body is <error>.toString() as plain text. Any error that is not an IHttpException. It also goes to the report method of the ExceptionHandler. Look at the server log.

docs.title: dox_core: DTOs, storage and config
docs.text: Text When What to do Bad state: This request has no session. Add SessionMiddleware() to globalMiddleware or to the route. req.session on a route with no SessionMiddleware. Do what the text says. See Session. Bad state: <T> is not a known DTO. Add @Dto() to it, rundart run build_runner buildand setdtos: dtos(lib/generated/dtos.g.dart) in AppConfig. req.validate<T>() can not find T. Do what the text says. Invalid argument(s): Storage disk "<name>" has unknown driver "<type>" A disk in StorageConfig has a driver other than local, s3 or memory. Fix the driver name. Invalid argument(s): Storage disk "<name>" needs the "<setting>" setting. It is missing or empty. An s3 disk without bucket, key or secret, on its first use. Set AWS_BUCKET, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY. Invalid argument(s): invalid file Storage().putFile() with bytes and no extension:, and Dox can not find the type from the bytes. Pass extension: 'pdf'. 403 invalid or expired signature A Storage.route() URL without a valid signature, or after expires. Make a new link with Storage().signedUrl(). 404 file not found Storage().stream(), download(), copy(), move(), getVisibility(), setVisibility(), size() or lastModified() of a missing file. Check the path. Invalid argument (trustedProxies): not an ip or cidr: "<value>" A bad entry in AppConfig.trustedProxies. Use an IP, a CIDR like 10.0.0.0/8, or *. Invalid argument (type): must be asc or desc: "<value>" orderBy(column, type) with another direction. Use asc or desc. 400 decrypt_failed, The encrypted value is not valid AESEncryptor.decode got changed text or a wrong key. It throws DecryptException. req.cookie() catches it and returns null. With the flag decryptServerError it is a 500 server_error and is reported. See Core flags. Check the key. For a cookie, ask the user to log in again.

docs.title: dox_auth
docs.text:
Text When What to do 401 Authentication failed AuthMiddleware finds no token, a bad or expired token, or the user is deleted. Send Authorization: Bearer <token>. Log in again. Invalid argument(s) (password): The password is too long. bcrypt takes at most 72 bytes. Hash.make() or Hash.makeAsync() with a password over 72 bytes. Limit the length in the DTO. See Troubleshooting. Invalid argument(s) (secret): The JWT secret is empty. Set APP_KEY (rundox key:generate). JwtAuthDriver with an empty secret. Set APP_KEY. Invalid argument(s) (secret): The JWT secret is <n> bytes. It must be at least 32 bytes. ... A short secret. In development, local, test and testing it is only a warning. Run dox key:generate. 401 The access token was already rotated. rotateAccessToken on a token that was rotated before. A token can be rotated only once. Use the new token. Bad state: The table 'auth_access_tokens' has no rotated_at column. ... rotateAccessToken on a token table without the rotated_at column. Add the column in a migration. See Authentication.

Hash.verify() gives false for a value that is not a bcrypt hash. It does not throw. Auth().attempt() returns null for a wrong password. It does not throw. More auth errors are in Authentication: Problems.

docs.title: dox_orm
docs.text: Text When What to do Unsupported operation: dox_postgres_native did not load: <reason>. Dox needs it to talk to Postgres. Fix: ... The native Postgres library did not load. The app stops. Follow the fix in the message. See Postgres native. Unsupported operation: dox_mysql_native did not load: <reason>. Dox needs it to talk to MySQL. Fix: ... The native MySQL library did not load. The app stops. Follow the fix in the message. See MySQL native. PgServerException(<code>): <message> The Postgres server said no, eg. code 23505 for a unique violation. Read code, detail and constraint on the exception. MysqlException(<code>, <sqlState>): <message> An error from MySQL, eg. code 1062 for a duplicate key. Read code and sqlState on the exception. Exception: <name> not found DatabaseConfig.connection (or withConnection()) names a connection that is not in connections. Fix DB_CONNECTION or the map. Exception: Invalid driver or not supported A ConnectionConfig.driver Dox can not open. Use Driver.postgres, Driver.mysql or Driver.sqlite. Invalid argument(s): dox_postgres_native: bad connection config The native driver can not read the connection values. Check host, port, user, database. Invalid argument(s): dox_mysql_native: bad connection config Same, for MySQL. Same. SqliteException with unable to open database file The SQLite folder does not exist. See Troubleshooting.

docs.title: dox_orm: schema builder
docs.text: Text When What to do Bad state: foreign key <name>: call on(table) table.foreign('x').references('id') with no .on('table'). Add .on('table'), or use foreignId('x').constrained(). Unsupported operation: postgres: change() of an auto increment column is not supported change() on an id() or increments() column. Write the ALTER by hand with schema.driver.execute(). Unsupported operation: sqlite: can not add a primary key to an existing table primary(...) in schema.table() on SQLite. Make the table again with the key in schema.create(). Unsupported operation: sqlite: can not rebuild <table>, it has CHECK constraints A SQLite rebuild (change(), foreign(), dropForeign()) on a table with other CHECKs. Make the new table by hand in the migration. Unsupported operation: sqlite: can not rebuild <table>, it has generated columns Same, on a table with generated columns. Same. Bad state: sqlite: table <table> not found A SQLite rebuild of a missing table. Check the table name. Bad state: sqlite: column <table>.<column> not found change() or renameColumn() of a missing column on SQLite. Check the column name. Bad state: sqlite: foreign key <names> not found dropForeign() of a key the table does not have. Check the key name or columns. Bad state: sqlite: rebuild of <table> breaks foreign keys After the rebuild, rows point to missing parent rows. Fix the data first. Unsupported operation: sqlite: change() rebuilds the table, it only runs on a database table.toSql(SqliteGrammar()) with change(). Run it on a database, not as text.

docs.title: dox_migration
docs.text:
Text When What to do Migration failed: <name> then the error A migration threw, or the migrator can not reach the database. Read the error below it. For a connection error, check DATABASE_URL or the DB_* values. A real env var wins over .env. Unknown migration command: <cmd> (use run, rollback, reset, refresh, fresh or status) dart run bin/migrate.dart <cmd> with another command. Use one of the six. Invalid argument(s): Invalid option <x>, use --step=<count> rollback with a bad option. Use --step=2. Bad state: Migration <name> is both a Dart and a .sql migration Two files with the same name in db/migration. Rename or delete one. Bad state: foreign key check failed: <table> points to a missing <parent> row SQLite: a migration left a broken foreign key. Fix the data in the migration. Migrating: <name> / Migrated: <name> Normal progress. Nothing. Migrations are already up to date! Nothing to run. Nothing. Nothing to rollback! No batch to undo. Nothing. No migrations found. status with no migrations. Check db/migration. Bad state: Seeder <name> not found. Seeders: <names> dox db:seed --class=<name> with a seeder that is not in db/seeders/seeders.dart. Check the name, or add the seeder to the list. Invalid argument(s): Unknown option <x>, use --class=<name> dox db:seed with another option. Use --class=UserSeeder.

See Migration.

docs.title: dox_cache
docs.text:
Text When What to do Invalid argument(s): Cache store "<name>" is not configured Cache().store('<name>') or defaultStore names a missing store. Add the store to CacheConfig.stores, or fix CACHE_STORE. Invalid argument(s): Cache driver "<driver>" of store "<name>" is not supported A store has a driver other than file, memory, redis or null. Fix the driver name. Unsupported operation: <Driver> does not support locks lock() on the file or null store. Use the memory or redis store. Bad state: Cache value of "<key>" is not an integer increment() or decrement() on a value that is not an int. Store an int, or forget() the key. Invalid argument(s): Cache value of "<key>" is bigger than <limit> bytes A Redis value is too big. Store less, or use files or a database. Bad state: RedisDriver.flush needs a prefix. It will not delete the whole database. flush() on a Redis store with an empty prefix. Set a prefix.

See Cache.

docs.title: dox_storage
docs.text:
The text has the form <Exception>: <message> (key: "<key>").

Text When What to do FileNotFoundException: File not found The file is not on the disk. Check the path. Storage() paths start with /, Disk keys do not. PermissionDeniedException: Permission denied The OS (local) or S3 (403) refused it. Check file rights, or the S3 key and bucket policy. InvalidKeyException: Invalid key: path traversal is not allowed A key with ... Do not build keys from user input. InvalidKeyException: Invalid key: absolute paths are not allowed A Disk key that starts with / or a drive letter. Remove the first /. InvalidKeyException: Invalid key: key is empty An empty key. Storage().deleteDirectory() with '', '/' or '.' also gives it, because the root is refused. Pass a file or folder name. UnsupportedOperationException: urlBase and appKey are needed for signed URLs signedUrl() on a local disk with no url, or no APP_KEY. Set both. UnsupportedOperationException: S3 signed URLs must expire within 1 second and 7 days signedUrl() on S3 with a bad expiresIn. Use a time up to 7 days. UnsupportedOperationException: Disk "<name>" is not registered Storage().disk('<name>') with a missing disk. Add the disk to StorageConfig.disks. DriverException: <S3 error> Any other S3 error (network, 500, wrong bucket). Read the S3 code in the text.

See File storage.

docs.title: dox_validation
docs.text:
Text When What to do Bad state: Schema has async rules. Use parseAsync() instead. schema.parse() on a schema with an async rule. Use await schema.parseAsync(). Bad state: Rule "<name>" is async. Use parseAsync() instead. Same, for one AsyncRule. Same. Bad state: This refine is async. Use parseAsync() instead. refine() with an async function and sync parse. Same. Bad state: DTO <name> has an async validate(). Use parseAsync() instead. A DTO with Future<void> validate() checked with a sync call. Use the async call, like req.validate<T>(). Bad state: No value: the key was missing. Check isPresent. maybe.value on a Maybe<T> that is missing. Check isPresent first.

See dox_validation.

docs.title: dox_builder (build_runner)
docs.text:
These stop dart run build_runner build.

Text When What to do The @Dto class <Name> has problems: then a - ... list One or more lines below. Fix each line. - The field <Class.field> must be final. A DTO field is not final. Add final. - The field <Class.field> must be athis.parameter of the unnamed constructor. The field is not set by the constructor. Add this.<field> to the constructor. - A @Dto class needs an unnamed constructor. Only named constructors. Add const Name({...}). - A @Dto class can not extend another class (<Parent>). The DTO extends a class. Copy the fields in. - A @Dto class can not be generic. The DTO has type parameters. Remove them. - The type <T> of <where> is not supported. Use a basic type, an enum, DateTime, RequestFile, a @Dto class, or a List or Map of them. Field type not supported. Change the type. - @<Rule> does not fit the type <T> of <where>. A rule on the wrong type, like @Email() on an int. Move the rule, or change the type. - @Length on <where> needs min:, max: or both. @Length() with no limit. Add min: or max:. - The @Regex on <where> is not a valid regex: <reason> The pattern does not compile. Fix the pattern. - @<Rule> on <where> needs a size like '2MB' (units B, KB, MB, GB), not "<text>". Bad size text on @MaxSize or @MinSize. Use '2MB'. - @Dimensions on <where> needs at least one limit, like minWidth:. @Dimensions() with no limit. Add a limit, like minWidth: 100. - The Maybe field <where> needs the defaultconst Maybe.missing(). A Maybe<T> field without that default. Add it. - <where> can not have both @Lowercase and @Uppercase. Both on one field. Keep one. - The validate method of <Name> must take one DtoErrors:void validate(DtoErrors errors). Wrong validate signature. Use that signature. Two @Dto classes are named <Name>: in <a> and <b>. Dox finds DTOs by name, so rename one. Two DTOs with the same class name. Rename one. Env getter "<name>" has type <T>. Use String, int, double, num, bool, Uri, Duration, an enum or List<String>. A @DoxEnv getter with another type. Change the type. @DoxModel can only be used on a class. / @DoxEnv can only be used on a class. The annotation is on something else. Put it on a class. Conflicting outputs were detected ... build_runner cache is out of date. See Troubleshooting.

docs.title: Native libraries (build hooks)
docs.text:
Printed during dart pub get, dox serve or dox build. <pkg> is dox_http_native, dox_postgres_native or dox_mysql_native.

There is no fallback. When a library is missing, the app stops with the reason and the fix. dox_http_native stops at start. The database drivers stop when the ORM opens the database.

Text When What to do <pkg>: no native library for <os>-<arch>. No ready build for this OS and CPU. Install Rust. <pkg>: download <file>: <status> / <pkg>: download <file> failed: <error> The GitHub download failed. Check the network, then dart pub get again. <pkg>: sha256 of <file> does not match The downloaded file is not the expected one. Delete .dart_tool and try again. <pkg>: cargo build failed The build from source failed. Read the cargo output below it. Bad state: <pkg>: <path> does not exist The lib_path user define points to a missing file. Fix the path in pubspec.yaml. <pkg> did not load: the native library is not in the build (...). The app opens Postgres or MySQL, but pubspec.yaml skips that driver. Remove its skip line. See Skip unused drivers. Unsupported operation: dox_http_native can not detach the socket. Use NativeWebSocket.upgrade for a WebSocket. Code called detachSocket() on a response. Rust owns the socket. For a WebSocket use NativeWebSocket.upgrade(request).

See Native server.

docs.title: dox_socketio
docs.text:
Printed to stderr. The connection or the request fails, the app keeps running.

Text When What to do dox_socketio: handler error: <error> Your namespace handler threw. The stack follows. Fix the handler. dox_socketio: request error: <error> A Socket.IO HTTP request failed. The client gets 500. Check the client version and transport. dox_socketio: publish failed: <error> The Redis or isolate adapter could not publish. Redis adapter: check Redis. Isolate adapter: it should not happen, so report it as a bug. dox_socketio: bad adapter message: <error> The Redis or isolate adapter got a message it can not read. Check that every app on the channel runs the same version.

docs.title: CLI
docs.text:
Text When What to do Could not find a command. Rundox helpfor more information. dox with no command. Run dox help. Could not find a command named "<name>". Rundox helpfor more information. Unknown command. A second line tells you about the dox: commands: key. Check the spelling. For a package command, run dart pub get after you add the package. More than one command is named "<name>", in: <packages>. ... Two commands (in two packages, or twice in one) have the same name. Exit code 1. Remove one of these packages, or ask its author to rename the command. Skip <package>:dox: commands: must be a library of the package itself, like package:<package>/commands.dart. The dox: commands: value is not package:<package>/<path>.dart, or has .., quotes or other characters. The other packages still work. Fix the value in that package's pubspec.yaml. Skip <package>:dox: commands:must be a library, like package:<package>/commands.dart. The value is not a string (like a list). Use one library. Skip <package>: <library> is not there (<path>). The commands library file is missing. The other packages still work. dox looks again on the next run. Make the file, or fix the key. Skip <package>: its pubspec.yaml is not valid YAML. The package's pubspec.yaml can not be read. Fix the YAML. Could not load the package commands: ... dox help could not run .dart_tool/dox/commands.dart (like a compile error in a commands library). The built-in commands are still listed. Fix the error it shows. bin/migrate.dart created. make:migration, or a migration:* command, made the missing entry file. Nothing. Invalid number of arguments for command "<name>". Too few or too many arguments. Run dox help <name>. Command "<name>" not found. dox help <name> with an unknown command. Run dox help. <name> already exists A make:* file is already there. Pick another name, or delete the file. Folder name "<name>" already exist dox create into a folder that exists. Pick another name. Unknown option <x> for <command>. dox make:model or dox make:controller with an option it does not know. Run dox help <command> to see the options. <command> takes 1 name, got 2: <words>. or <command> takes 1 name, got 0. dox make:model or dox make:controller with no name (like dox make:model -m), or with an extra word after the name (like dox make:model Pen extra). Give one name. --model needs a value, like --model=Post. dox make:controller with --model and no model name. Use --model=Post. Invalid option <x>, use --step=<count> dox migration:rollback with another option. Use --step=2. Skip <file>: no class that extends Migration. A Dart file in db/migration has no migration class. Add class X extends Migration, or move the file. .env.example is missing. dox env:generate with no example file. Make .env.example. lib/config/env.dart is already there. Delete it to make it again. dox env:generate again. Delete the file, or edit it by hand. lib/config/env.dart is missing. Rundox env:generatefirst. dox env:check with no env class. Run dox env:generate. pubspec.yaml has no name. dox env:check can not find the package name. Add name: to pubspec.yaml. bin/openapi.dart is missing. Make it with: ... dox openapi:generate with no entry file. Make bin/openapi.dart. See OpenAPI. zsh: command not found: dox $HOME/.pub-cache/bin is not in PATH. See Troubleshooting.

See CLI.

docs.title: HTTP exceptions
docs.text:
An exception that extends IHttpException turns into an HTTP error answer.

You can throw it or return it from a middleware or a controller.

IHttpException is in packages/dox-annotation/lib/src/core_annotation.dart:

abstract class IHttpException {
  int code = 500;
  String errorCode = 'server_error';
  dynamic message = 'Server Error';

  dynamic toResponse() {
    if (message is Map) {
      return message;
    }
    return <String, dynamic>{'code': errorCode, 'message': message.toString()};
  }
}

docs.title: The classes
docs.text:
Most classes take the named parameters message, errorCode and code. The table shows the defaults. message is a String or a Map, like NotFoundHttpException(message: {'error': 'not_found'}).

Class Package Status code errorCode Default message Dox throws it when BadRequestException dox_core 400 bad_request Bad Request the body can not be read, like JSON that is not valid UnAuthorizedException dox_auth 401 unauthorized Authentication failed AuthMiddleware finds no valid token ForbiddenHttpException dox_core 403 forbidden Forbidden never by itself; for your own use NotFoundHttpException dox_core 404 not_found Not Found no route fits the path, a typed path param does not fit ({id} is not an int), or a route model binding finds no row MethodNotAllowedHttpException dox_core 405 method_not_allowed Method Not Allowed the path has routes, but not for this method. The Allow header lists the methods. PayloadTooLargeException dox_core 413 payload_too_large Payload Too Large the body is bigger than maxBodySize or maxMultipartSize UnsupportedMediaTypeException dox_core 415 unsupported_media_type Unsupported Media Type a DTO reads a body that is not JSON and not form data TokenMismatchException dox_core 419 csrf_token_mismatch CSRF token mismatch CsrfMiddleware finds no CSRF token, or a wrong one ValidationException dox_core 422 validation_failed {} (a Map) a DTO or req.validate() finds bad input TooManyRequestsException dox_core 429 too_many_requests Too Many Requests a RateLimit middleware sees too many requests InternalErrorException dox_core 500 server_error Server Error never by itself; for your own use QueryException dox_core 500 sql_query_error Error in sql query never by itself; for your own use

Source files: packages/dox-core/lib/exception/*.dart and lib/src/auth_exception.dart in dartondox/dox-auth.

docs.title: What the client gets
docs.text:
responseDataHandler in packages/dox-core/lib/http/http_response_handler.dart sends the answer:

  1. The status is set to code.
  2. The body is toResponse().
  3. The body is sent as JSON with Content-Type: application/json.

A text message gives a JSON body with the errorCode and the message:

throw NotFoundHttpException(message: 'Blog not found');

HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
content-type: application/json

{"code":"not_found","message":"Blog not found"}

A Map message is sent as it is, with no code key, and with the status of the exception:

throw NotFoundHttpException(message: <String, String>{'error': 'not_found'});
// 404 {"error":"not_found"}

ValidationException always has a map, one entry per field:

HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
content-type: application/json

{"email":"The email is not a valid email","name":"The name is required"}

A request for a path that has no route answers like a NotFoundHttpException with the message <METHOD> <path> not found: {"code":"not_found","message":"GET /nothing not found"}. When the path has routes for other methods, the answer is 405 with an Allow header, like Allow: GET, POST, HEAD. Your responseHandler gets it too, so you can change its shape.

To send your own JSON shape, make your own exception class (see below) and override toResponse().

Other errors: any Exception or Error that is not an IHttpException gets 500 with {"code": "server_error", "message": "Server Error"}. When APP_ENV is development or local, the body is error.toString() as text instead. It is also passed to the report method of the exception handler. An IHttpException with a 4xx code is not reported. One with a 5xx code is.

A ValidationException on a request with a session (SessionMiddleware) that does not want JSON, like a form post, is not sent as JSON. Dox saves the errors and the old input in the session and redirects back.

A ValidationException from dox_validation (thrown by schema.parse() in a controller) is turned into the 422 ValidationException of dox_core with the same errors.

docs.title: Any status: abort and HttpStatusException
docs.text:
abort(code) stops the request and answers with that status. It throws an HttpStatusException.

if (post.userId != req.auth?.id()) abort(403);
abort(404, 'No post with this id');
throw HttpStatusException(503, headers: {'retry-after': '60'});

HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json

{"code":"forbidden","message":"Forbidden"}

Common codes get a default errorCode and message, like forbidden / Forbidden for 403. Other codes get http_error / Error. The headers are sent with the answer.

docs.title: Make your own
docs.text:
Extend IHttpException and set the three fields in the constructor:

import 'dart:io';

import 'package:dox_core/dox_core.dart';

class PaymentRequiredException extends IHttpException {
  PaymentRequiredException({
    dynamic message = 'Please pay',
    String errorCode = 'payment_required',
    int code = HttpStatus.paymentRequired,
  }) {
    super.code = code;
    super.errorCode = errorCode;
    super.message = message;
  }
}

Override toResponse() to give every error of your app the same JSON shape.

More examples are on the Response page.

docs.title: Production checklist
docs.text:
This page lists what to check before you deploy a Dox app.

Items marked Dox limit are things Dox does not do for you. You must handle them outside Dox.

docs.title: Secrets and config
docs.text:
If APP_ENV is empty or not set, Dox treats the app as production: /docs is off and error details are hidden. Set APP_ENV=development in your local .env and in CI.

Check How Read more APP_KEY is set, 32 characters and secret dox key:generate, or a random value of exactly 32 characters in the real env. It signs JWT tokens and encrypts cookies. Never use the value from .env.example. Encryption APP_ENV=production Set it, or leave it empty. In production, a bad APP_KEY stops the app at start with a StateError: an empty key, a key that is not exactly 32 characters, or a public sample key. Only with APP_ENV development, local, test or testing does Dox log a warning instead. Env reference The env is complete Run dox env:check in CI or before the deploy. It exits with code 1 when a key is missing or bad. CLI No secrets in the image or in git .env in .dockerignore and .gitignore. Pass values as env vars (docker run -e, env_file:, systemd EnvironmentFile=). dox build copies .env.example only. Docker No comments after values in .env The app strips # note, but migrations keep it in the value. Put comments on their own line. Env reference

docs.title: Auth and passwords
docs.text: Check How Read more JWT tokens expire JwtAuthDriver.expiresIn is 1 hour by default. Pick a time that fits your app, like JwtAuthDriver(secret: SecretKey(env.appKey), expiresIn: Duration(hours: 12)). Authentication A JWT works until it expires By default there is no token list on the server. Turn on revocation: true in JwtAuthDriver to use revokeToken and revokeAllTokens. Or use AccessTokenAuthDriver: its tokens live in a table and you can revoke each one. To log out everyone, change APP_KEY with no previousKeys. Authentication Passwords are hashed user.password = await Hash.makeAsync(input) (bcrypt). In a request, use makeAsync: it runs bcrypt in another isolate, so other requests do not wait. Never store or encrypt a plain password. Hashing The hash is never sent List<String> get hidden => <String>['password']; in the user model. The JWT payload is user.toJson(), and anyone can read it. Authentication Passwords have a max length bcrypt takes at most 72 bytes. Hash.make and Hash.makeAsync throw an ArgumentError on longer input. Add @MaxLength(72) to the password field of the DTO. It counts characters, so non-ASCII text can still pass 72 bytes. Troubleshooting

docs.title: HTTP and network
docs.text: Check How Read more HTTPS at the proxy Dox has no TLS server. Run Caddy or nginx in front. Keep the app port private. Deployment trustedProxies is set behind a proxy AppConfig(trustedProxies: <String>['127.0.0.1', '::1']), or the proxy network, like '172.16.0.0/12'. Without it, req.ip() is the proxy and req.scheme() is http. Do not use ['*'] when the app port is public. App config Body limits are on Keep maxBodySize (10 MB) and maxMultipartSize (100 MB), or lower them. Set the same limit in the proxy: client_max_body_size 100m; Request CORS has real origins CORSConfig(origin: 'https://my.app'), or a list like <String>['https://my.app', 'https://admin.my.app']. With a list, Dox sends back only the request origin when it is in the list. CORS No credentials: true with origin: '*' The new project's cors.dart has origin: <String>['http://localhost:3000'], credentials: true and enabled: false. When you turn CORS on, put your real origins in the list. CORS Rate limiting Add RateLimit(...) to login and other busy routes. Use a Redis cache store, so all servers share the counts. Or limit at the proxy, see below. Rate limiting Security headers Add const SecurityHeaders() to globalMiddleware. Security headers gzip at the proxy Keep compress: false. Turn on gzip in Caddy (encode gzip) or nginx (gzip on;). Performance OpenAPI docs Off unless APP_ENV is development or local. Do not set enabled: true for a private API. OpenAPI

docs.title: Build and run
docs.text: Check How Read more AOT binary, not dart run dox build, then run build/bundle/bin/server. Keep bin/ and lib/ together. Not dart compile exe. Deployment Native server loads The app starts and the start line says (native). When the library does not load, the app stops with dox_http_native did not load and the fix. Native server Native database driver loads The app starts and the database works. When the library does not load, the app stops with dox_postgres_native did not load (or mysql) and the fix. Postgres native Isolates = cores Keep the default totalIsolate (Platform.numberOfProcessors), or set APP_TOTAL_ISOLATE to the cores the container really gets. Use fewer when the database runs on the same machine. With SQLite, writes run one at a time, and each isolate has its own heap and database connection. 1-2 isolates are enough for a small app. Isolate Shared state across isolates Cache: redis, not memory. Socket.IO: transports: ['websocket'] on the client, and a Redis adapter with many servers. Isolate A supervisor restarts the process Docker restart: unless-stopped, or systemd Restart=always. Dox restarts a dead worker isolate, but not the main isolate. Deployment Writable temp folder Uploads over 1 MB go to a temp file. A FROM scratch image needs /tmp with mode 1777. Docker Uploads live on a volume or S3 The local disk writes to storage/. Mount it as a volume, or use the s3 disk. File storage

docs.title: Database
docs.text: Check How Read more Postgres or MySQL for a busy app SQLite has one connection per isolate, and a query blocks the isolate. Use it for small apps only. With SQLite use an absolute file path, never :memory: with many isolates. Database Migrations run once per deploy The new project runs Migrator(...).migrate() in bin/server.dart before startServer(). Or run dox migrate (same as dart run bin/migrate.dart run) once in CI. With many machines, run migrations in one place only, so two machines do not migrate at the same time. Migration Migrations use the right database dox_migration reads .env and the real env. A real env var wins, but a key that is only in an old .env is still used. Do not ship a .env next to the binary, or give Migrator(config: ...) your own config. Migration Small MySQL migrations MySQL saves CREATE, ALTER and DROP at once. A failed migration can leave half the changes. One table change per migration. Migration Pool size fits the database extra: {'maxConnectionCount': 10}. The Postgres and MySQL drivers share one pool per process, so the total is the pool size, not isolates x pool size. Keep it under the database max_connections. Database Query logging is off debug: true prints every query. The new project's database.dart sets debug only when APP_ENV=development. Database Backups Dox limit. Dox has no backup tool. Use pg_dump, mysqldump, managed database snapshots, or a copy of the SQLite file (with the -wal file, or sqlite3 app.db ".backup x.db"). Test a restore.

docs.title: Logs and errors
docs.text: Check How Read more JSON logs LoggerConfig(enabled: true, prettyPrint: false). The new project sets prettyPrint only when APP_ENV=development. App config Log level Set LOG_LEVEL=warn to print only warnings and errors. App config Access logs in one place LogMiddleware logs one line per request through Logger. Lines are written in batches, every 20 ms, so a hard kill can lose the last lines. A warn, warning, danger or error line is written at once. The new project turns it off when APP_ENV=production, because the proxy already logs requests. Performance Errors go to your tracker Extend ExceptionHandler and set AppConfig.exceptionHandler. Any non-HTTP error is passed to its report method. The client gets 500 with server_error. The error text is sent only when APP_ENV is development or local. Error handling

docs.title: Health and shutdown
docs.text: Check How Read more Health route Add Route.health('/health', checks: ...) with a database check, so the load balancer knows when the app can not serve. Health check Graceful shutdown On SIGTERM or SIGINT, Dox stops taking connections and lets open requests finish, in every isolate. Set shutdownTimeout below the kill timeout of your platform. The ORMProvider closes the database in its shutdown(), and Dox closes the cache stores. Close your own connections in the shutdown() of a provider. Deployment Zero downtime deploys Run two processes (or machines) behind the proxy. Restart one at a time. Deployment

docs.title: Rate limit at the proxy
docs.text:
You can also limit at the proxy. Then bad clients never reach the app.

nginx:

# in http { }
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=api:10m rate=10r/s;

# in server { location / { } }
limit_req zone=api burst=20 nodelay;
limit_req_status 429;

Caddy needs the caddy-ratelimit plugin (build Caddy with xcaddy build --with github.com/mholt/caddy-ratelimit):

example.com {
  rate_limit {
    zone api {
      key    {remote_host}
      events 100
      window 1m
    }
  }
  reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:3000
}

Note

The proxy must see the real client IP. When there is a load balancer in front of the proxy, set the real IP module of the proxy first.

docs.title: Request and response
docs.text:
A short list of the members of DoxRequest, DoxResponse and the response helpers.

Examples and explanations are on the Request and Response pages.

docs.title: DoxRequest
docs.text: Source: packages/dox-core/lib/http/request/dox_request.dart. It implements IDoxRequest from dox_annotation. A simple middleware (IDoxMiddleware) gets an IDoxRequest. A controller and a next middleware (IDoxNextMiddleware) get a DoxRequest. The members marked IDoxRequest are on both.

docs.title: Input
docs.text: Member Returns What it gives On IDoxRequest validate<T>({Source? source}) Future<T> The request checked with the DTO T. Throws the 422 ValidationException on bad input. Throws StateError when T is not in AppConfig.dtos. no validateSchema<O>(Schema<O> schema) Future<O> Query and body checked with a fluent dox_validation schema. no all() Map<String, dynamic> Query and body together. Body wins on the same key. yes only(List<String> keys) Map<String, dynamic> Only these keys from all(). A missing key gives null. yes input(String key, [dynamic defaultValue]) dynamic One value from all(). A dot key like user.name or items.0.id reads inside maps and lists. The default is used when the key is not there or is null. IDoxRequest has input(key) only, with no default value. yes except(List<String> keys) Map<String, dynamic> All values from all(), without these keys. no has(String key) bool true when the key is there and its text is not empty. yes exists(String key) bool true when the key is there, with any value (also '' or null). no missing(String key) bool true when the key is not there. no filled(String key) bool true when the key is there and not empty. Dot keys work. no boolean(String key, [bool defaultValue = false]) bool true for true, 1, on and yes. no integer(String key, [int defaultValue = 0]) int The value as an int. The default is used when the key is not there or is not a number. no file(String key) RequestFile? The uploaded file, or null when the field is not a file. no hasFile(String key) bool true when the field holds a file or a list of files. no add(String key, dynamic value) void Adds a value to all() and body. yes merge(Map<String, dynamic> values) void Adds many values to all() and body. yes body Map<String, dynamic> The parsed body (JSON or form fields). Files are RequestFile. no query Map<String, dynamic> The query string. no param Map<String, dynamic> The route params, like {'id': '5'}. no pathParams Map<String, String> The route params as text. null values are left out. no bound<T>(String param) T The value that Route.bind made for this route param. Throws StateError when there is none. no requestBody RequestBody The body as it was read, for DTOs. no isJson() bool The content type is JSON. yes isFormData() bool The content type is form data (multipart/form-data or urlencoded). yes toJson() Map<String, dynamic> all() with files replaced by their file name. Lets jsonEncode(req) work. yes

docs.title: Headers, cookies and client
docs.text: Member Returns What it gives On IDoxRequest header(String key) String? One header. null when it is not there. yes headers Map<String, dynamic> Every header. Many values of one name are joined. yes httpHeaders HttpHeaders The dart:io headers object. no contentType ContentType? The parsed Content-Type. yes bearerToken() String? The token of Authorization: Bearer <token>, or null. no cookie(String key, {bool decrypt = true}) String? One cookie. Decrypted with appKey unless decrypt: false. yes ip() String The client IP, or unknown. From X-Forwarded-For only behind a trusted proxy. yes scheme() String http or https. From X-Forwarded-Proto only behind a trusted proxy. no isSecure() bool scheme() is https. no clientIp String? The client IP, or null. no userAgent() String The User-Agent header, or unknown. yes host() String The Host header, or unknown. yes origin() String? The Origin header. yes referer() String? The Referer header. yes locale String? The first language of Accept-Language, like th. null when there is none or it is *. no auth IAuth? The auth object set by AuthMiddleware, or null. req.auth?.id() gives the user id. For a guest, req.auth is null. yes expectsJson() bool The client wants JSON: an Accept header with json, a JSON body, or X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest. An Inertia request is not. no

docs.text: Member Returns What it gives On IDoxRequest session Session The session of the request. Needs SessionMiddleware. Throws StateError without it. no hasSession bool true when the request has a session. no
